from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    year: str | None = Field(description="The publication year of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the works cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed papers from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
